uvr 0.1.3
  • Reference

Run an R script in the project environment

run.Rd

Executes a script with the project library active. Equivalent to uvr run script.R on the command line. For interactive R, use the CLI directly: uvr run.

Usage

run(script, args = NULL, bin = NULL, dir = NULL, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

script

Path to an R script.

args

Character vector of arguments forwarded to the script. Defaults to NULL for no arguments.

bin

Optional path to the uvr binary. If NULL, searches common locations using find_uvr.

dir

Optional working directory. Defaults to getwd().

quiet

If TRUE, suppress output.

Value

A character vector of output lines (returned invisibly). On failure, throws an error with the exit code.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run("analysis.R")
run("model.R", args = c("--seed", "42"))
} # }
